Accommodation description

Porto Matina is a seaside hotel in Metamorfosi, Sithonia, only 200m from center and main facilities. The hotel offers studios and apartments for 4-6 guests. Built in an area of 10,000 m2, the complex features a beautiful garden, a restaurant, a beach bar, children's playground, and many other amenities.

Show full description Hide the rest

Accommodation

The hotel has over 30 accommodation units distributed on the ground, first, and second floors. There are three two-room apartments on the ground floor with sea views.

The units are air-conditioned and equipped with satellite television and free Wi-Fi internet. They have private bathrooms with hair dryers and furnished terraces with sea and garden views. They are cleaned daily, while towels and bed linen are changed every other day.

It is important to note that the units do not have a kitchen, but only a refrigerator and an electric kettle.

The hotel complex includes a spacious, beautifully landscaped garden with outdoor furniture and table tennis equipment. A playground, animations, and a summer cinema are provided for the youngest guests. Thematic Greek evenings are also organized.

On the beach, which can be reached by stairs, is a hotel bar with sunbeds and umbrellas which guests are free to use with a consumption.

Guests can park their cars in front and in the streets around the hotel.

Location and nearby beaches

Metamorfosi, Sithonia

Metamorfosi is a peaceful village on the northern side of Sithonia, known for its pine forests, fresh air, and calm coastal atmosphere. The shoreline here has small sandy and pebbly beaches with clear, warm water that is comfortable for swimming. Accommodation includes family-run apartments, small hotels, and holiday homes surrounded by greenery, which gives the village a relaxing, natural feel. Metamorfosi is not a crowded resort, so the pace is slow and suitable for families and travelers who want a restful holiday. The village has taverns, cafés, and a few shops for everyday needs, while larger centers like Nikiti are just a short drive away. Pine trees provide natural shade along parts of the coast, making beach time pleasant even on hotter days. With its quiet environment and convenient location, Metamorfosi is a good base for exploring the beaches of northern Sithonia.
